Our field team visits partner studios to review how the materials hold up in daily use. The guide explains which settings matter first and which can safely wait. Readers who follow the steps in order finish the setup without needing support. Configuration files are read once at start-up and validated before any work begins.

A missing value falls back to the documented default and is reported in the log. Teams usually adopt the recommended layout and change it only when a project grows.
